package day2;

public class weekly_Assignment_4_10_26 {

	public static void main(String[] args) {
		// TODO Auto-generated method stub
		
		//1.reverse a number
		int num=12345;
		int reverse=0;
		for(;num>0;)
		{
			int lastdigit=num%10;
			reverse=reverse*10+lastdigit;
			num=num/10;
		}
		System.out.println(reverse);

		
		//2.Count digits
		int value=987654;
		int count=0;
		for(;value>0;)
		{
			value=value/10;	
			count++;
		}
		System.out.println("Number of didgits = "+count);
		
				
				
		//3.Armstrong number

		int num=93084;
		int noOfdigits=0;
		int original=num;
		int armstrong=0;
		for(;num>0;)
		{
			noOfdigits++;
			num=num/10;
		}
		num=original;
		for(;num>0;)
		{
			int lastdigit=num%10;
			int multiply=1;
			for(int i=1;i<=noOfdigits;i++)
				multiply=multiply*lastdigit;
			armstrong=armstrong+multiply;
			num=num/10;	
		}
		System.out.println(armstrong);
		if(original==armstrong)
			System.out.println(armstrong+" is an Armstrong number");
		else
			System.out.println(armstrong+" is not an Armstrong number");
		
		
		//4.Even and Odd numbers
		int num=20;
		int value=num;
		int evennumber=0;
		System.out.println("Even numbers:");
		for(int i=1;i<=num;i++)
		{
			evennumber=i%2;
			if(evennumber==0)
				System.out.print(i+" ");
		}
		System.out.println();
		System.out.println("Odd numbers:");
		num=value;
		for(int j=1;j<=num;j++)
		{
			if(j%2!=0)
				System.out.print(j+" ");
		}
		
		
		
		//5.sum of all even number(1to50) using for loop
		
		int num=50;
		int sumOfeven=0;
		for(int i=1;i<=num;i++)
		{
			if(i%2==0)
				sumOfeven=sumOfeven+i;
		}
		System.out.println("Sum of even numbers="+sumOfeven);
		
		
		
		//6.Palindrome number
		int num=12345;
		int original=num;
		int reverse=0;
		for(;num>0;)
		{
			int lastdigit=num%10;
			reverse=reverse*10+lastdigit;
			num=num/10;
		}
		System.out.println(reverse);
		if(original==reverse)
			System.out.println("Palindrome");
		else
			System.out.println("Not a palindrome");
		
		
		
	}

}
